title: Oxalis Flower Atlas

paper.author: Chris Brinegar
paper.title: The true redwood sorrel: Reinstatement of Oxalis smalliana (Oxalidaceae) as a species separate from Oxalis oregana

color.name: Redwood Sorrel Petal Color
color.description: Upper petal background, ignoring veins and throat. Our Fig.1 key: Pink A-F; Purple G-H; White I-P. Cannot be determined if unresolved. Rules: https://twsummer.github.io/OxalisFlowerColors/protocol.md#petal-color

veins.name: Redwood Sorrel Petal Vein Contrast
veins.description: Vein contrast against upper petal background. Our Fig.1 key: High O,P; Medium A,F,H; Low B,C,D,E,G,I,J,K,L,M,N. Unclear: Cannot be determined. Rules: https://twsummer.github.io/OxalisFlowerColors/protocol.md#petal-vein-contrast

ring.name: Redwood Sorrel White Center Ring
ring.description: Ring outside yellow/orange throat: Absent=no band; Faint=weak localized band; Clear=obvious edges. Unresolved ring vs pigment variation: Cannot be determined. Rules: https://twsummer.github.io/OxalisFlowerColors/protocol.md#white-center-ring

variation.name: Redwood Sorrel Petal Pigment Variation
variation.description: Petal background variation outside throat, ring and veins; exclude lighting. None=uniform; Low=subtle; High=strong variation in any arrangement (F is one example). Rules: https://twsummer.github.io/OxalisFlowerColors/protocol.md#petal-pigment-variation

categoryBasis: Project owner interpretation of Brinegar (2022) Figure 1; intentionally different from the paper categories.
